subject: Introduction of Curtis-Tufts Principal Laurie Hodgdon
overview: Dr. Laurie Hodgdon introduced herself as the new principal of Curtis-Tufts High School and outlined the school's mission as a therapeutic public day school.

items.title: Welcome and School Overview
items.summary: Dr. Laurie Hodgdon introduced herself as the new principal and described Curtis-Tufts as a therapeutic public day school serving students with individualized education plans for over 35 years.

items.title: Enrollment and Staffing
items.summary: The principal highlighted the school's intimate setting, featuring class sizes limited to eight students and a total school capacity of forty students supported by specialized staff.

items.title: Educational Vision and Philosophy
items.summary: Dr. Hodgdon shared her philosophy of focusing on small improvements to achieve student success and emphasized her commitment to building collaborative partnerships with families.
